## Individual cookie settings

Here you can find an overview of all cookies used. You can give your consent to entire categories or view more information and thus select only certain cookies.

[Accept all](# "Ich bin mit der Verwendung von Cookies einverstanden") [Accept essential cookies](# "Accept essential cookies")

**Essential cookies (7):**

**Provider:** Museum Brandhorst

**Purpose:**  
These cookies are required for the website to work. They store your preferred language, whether you have already answered the cookie banner, your choices in the cookie banner and a random ID that allows us to demonstrate your consent. They also remember that our fonts have already been loaded. **Cookie names:**  
pll_language, cookie-modal, consent-tracking, consent-youtube, consent-spotify, consent-id, fonts-loaded **Cookie duration:**  
365

**Analyse cookies (2):**

**Provider:** Matomo

Matomo: From

**Purpose:**  
These cookies are used to identify returning visitors and to collect data about the current visit. **Cookie names:**  
_pk_id, _pk_ses **Cookie duration:**  
13 months / 30 minutes

**Marketing Cookies (8):**

**Provider:** Youtube

Youtube: From

**Purpose:**  
These cookies are used to store your current bandwidth and determine whether you get the new or old player interface. Also, a unique ID is collected to keep statistics about which YouTube videos you have watched. **Cookie names:**  
VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE, YSC **Cookie duration:**  
8 months / session

**Provider:** Spotify

Spotify: From

**Purpose:**  
These cookies are used to enable the embedding Spotify content on our website. A unique ID is also collected to keep statistics on which Spotify tracks you have listened to and to provide you with the best user experience. **Cookie names:**  
_spotify_sso, sp_t, sp_dc, sp_landing, _gcl_au, OptanonConsent **Cookie duration:**  
12 months / session

## Free admission

Admission to Museum Brandhorst is free of charge for children and teenagers up to the age of 18. Learn more about our program for kids and families.

[Learn more](https://www.museum-brandhorst.de/en/children-families/)
